media.alt: International Academics & Educators to attend AKU-IED's Education Conference on quality in education

content.text: The Aga Khan University Institute for Educational Development (AKU-IED) is holding a three-day international conference on "Quality in Education: Teaching and Leadership in Challenging Times" from February 21-23, 2006. Dr Hamida Khuhro, Minister for Education and Literacy, Government of Sindh, will be the Chief Guest at the opening ceremony to be held at the AKU Auditorium in Karachi.

The conference aims to disseminate educational research and learning from the experiences of practitioners, debate issues of quality in education, and identify the key factors in the provision of quality education. The papers and ensuing discussion will focus on three conference themes: Quality in teacher education; Leadership for quality teaching; Globalisation and teaching and learning.

Academics, researchers and educators from Canada, East Africa, India, Malaysia, Pakistan, Poland, Sri Lanka, Tajikistan, and UK are participating in the conference. The keynote speakers at the conference include Dr Quratulain Bakhtiari, Director, Institute for Development Studies and Practices, Quetta; Dr Angela W. Little, Professor and Chair of Education, Institute of Education, University of London; and Dr Manzoor Ahmed, Director of BRAC University, Institute of Educational Development, Bangladesh.

AKU-IED aims to improve the quality of education in less developed countries through capacity building efforts involving research, educational programmes, partnerships, policy initiatives and commitment towards wider social development. Within a relatively short timeframe, AKU-IED has successfully established a set of educational initiatives which form the basis of a coherent programmatic approach to school improvement and broader social development. The programmes are attended by a diverse group of participants representing Afghanistan, Central Asia (Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan), East Africa, South Asia, and Syria.

This conference will further identify new areas of academic and research programmes for AKU-IED and explore avenues for working collaboratively with public and private sector education institutions within and outside Pakistan for enhancing quality of education and promoting culture of research and scholarship.
